no_projects: No projects yet. Make one and save it.
tip_position: Bar and beat. Click to change the time signature.
toast_group_need2: Select at least two clips to group
toast_group_nested: You cannot put a group inside a group yet
tip_track_delete: Delete this track and its clips
tip_eq: Boost or cut {band} on "{name}". Double-click to reset.
insp_select: Select a clip on the timeline to edit it here.
tip_clip_pitch: Real pitch shift. Keeps the same length.
set_note: Projects save as .fab files, sounds included. Export makes a WAV audio file.
tip_countin: Four beats count you in before recording.
proll_hint: click to add, drag to move, edge for length, right-click to delete
toast_drop_here: Drop an audio file here, or record with R
hint_drop_at_bar: Drop to place the sound at bar {bar}.
toast_not_audio: That is not an audio or MIDI file
toast_take_new_lane: Take added on a new lane so it does not overlap
hint_take_added: Take added. Double-click it to edit the notes.
hint_clip_selected: Drag to move, double-click to edit, right-click to delete, Cmd D to duplicate.
toast_select_clip_split: Select a clip to split first
toast_move_playhead_split: Move the playhead inside the clip to split it
toast_no_paste_track: No matching track to paste on
hint_audio_clip: Double-click an audio clip for gain, pitch and fades.
toast_sound_decode_fail: A sound could not be decoded
auto_hint: Click to add a point, drag to move, right-click to delete. Scroll for higher or lower values.
auto_empty: No keyframes. Click to add one.
samp_hint: Drag a loop onto the timeline. They are editable patterns, so double-click to tweak the notes.
tip_samp_root: The note the sample plays at its original pitch
hint_welcome: Drop a sound anywhere, or double-click an instrument lane to add notes.
samp_zoom_hint: Scroll to zoom, drag the edges to trim
jam_hint: Share the room code with a friend to make music together, live.
tip_speed: Playback speed. Changes length and pitch.
tip_pattern_speed: Play the pattern faster or slower. Changes how much timeline it takes up.
tip_finepitch: Fine pitch, in cents (100 = one semitone)
exit_sub: Your project has changes that are not saved to a file.
auth_sub: You need an account to play together.
auth_taken: Username already taken. Try another one.
auth_weak: Password too short, use at least 6 characters.
mp_join_sub: Enter the code the host gave you.
mp_create_sub: Pick a project and your room rules.
mp_waiting: Waiting for the host to let you in…
mp_not_connected: Not in a room. Open Multiplayer from the home menu, or create a room now.
mp_code_tip: Click to reveal, click again to copy
mp_allow_audio: Allow custom audio files from everybody
mp_no_custom_audio: The host turned off custom sounds in this room.
mp_no_mic: The host turned off microphone recording in this room.
mp_audio_needs_approval: Drop the file onto the timeline so the host can review it.
mp_audio_too_big: "{name}" is too big to send for review
mp_audio_sent: Sent to the host for review
mp_ban_audio_sub: They will not be able to add or request custom sounds for a while.
mp_manage_sub: Choose who can add custom sounds or record from the mic, and lift bans.
mp_cycle_tip: New code, old one gets made invalid but everyone stays
mp_code_cycled: New room code set. The old one no longer works.
mp_requests_sub: People asking to join your room.
mp_banned: You were removed from this room. Try again later.
mp_kicked_perm: The host removed you from this session.
mp_kicked_until: The host removed you. You can rejoin at {time}.
size_title: I don't really know how you managed this.
size_sub: You've hit the file size limit for a shared project. You can export it as it is, or keep editing on your own until it is smaller, so the others will wait.
acct_delete_note: This permanently removes your account. It cannot be undone.
tip_transpose: Shift every note up or down
update_available: A new version of fabu is out
update_note: Click update and fabu installs it for you.
upd_ready_sub: The new version is downloaded. fabu needs to restart to finish. Save your work first.
upd_restart_countdown: Restarting in {n} seconds. Save now if you need to.
update_failed: Could not update by itself. The download page is open, grab the new version there.
mp_waking: Waking up the server… this can take a minute
set_check_failed: Could not check. Are you online?
set_web_version: fabu web, always the latest version
hint_clips_selected: {n} clips selected. Drag moves them together, edge-drag resizes them together.
fx_hint: Drag an effect onto a clip. Right-click the clip to edit or remove it.
fx_none_on_clip: No effects on this clip. Drag some from the Effects window.
fx_editor_sub: Changes apply right away, also while playing.
tip_eq_canvas: Drag the points to shape the EQ. Double-click a point to reset it.
tip_midi: Play and record instruments from a connected MIDI keyboard.
set_midi_none: No MIDI keyboard detected. Plug one in and it appears here.
tip_pump: Sidechain "{name}": ducks it on every beat for a pumping groove
tip_eco: Turns off the room reverb and limits voices so playback stays smooth.
tip_scrub: Hear the notes under the playhead as you drag it (when stopped).
empty_hint: Double-click here to add a pattern
set_mic_hint: Record once to see device names.
tip_samples: Loops to drag onto the timeline
samp_drag_hint: Drag it anywhere onto your song.
hint_drop_loop: Drop to add this loop at bar {bar}.
mixeq_pick: Click a track below to shape its EQ.
tut_instr_b: Pick a different instrument here. The same notes, a different sound.
tut_add_b: Add a second track. Layers on top of each other are what makes it a song.
tut_samp_b: Open the loops. Drag one onto your song and it plays straight away.
tut_jam_b: Start a room and a friend builds the track live with you. That is it, have fun.
tip_track_swing: Swing "{name}": nudges its offbeats for groove
home_example_link: New here? Open the example song
hc_continue_sub: Pick up where you left off
toast_demo_loaded: Example loaded. Press play, then take it apart.
tip_scale_show: Shade the notes that fit the key
tip_scale_snap: Pull drawn notes onto the key
tip_chord: Click drops a full chord in the key
tip_quantize: Line notes up to the grid
tip_samp_item: Click to hear it, drag or double-click to add it
toast_quantized: Lined {n} notes up to the grid
mp_history_sub: What people have added or removed in this room.
mp_soundban_title: You can no longer add sounds
mp_soundban_sub: The host turned off your custom sounds {how}.
mp_ban_until_host: until the host allows it again
mp_player_tip: Shift-click to select, right-click for options
tip_loop: Repeat a section (L). Shift-drag the ruler to set it.
auth_no_user: No account called "{name}". Want to create one?
auth_profane: Sorry, please pick a different username.
auth_pw_joke: what a funny password! you're a real comedian!
auth_stale: Signed out: the account "{name}" no longer exists.
hist_blocked: {name} tried a change that was blocked ({what})
help_loop: Repeat a section on and off
help_new_track: Drop in the gap for a new track
upd_restart_later: Update will finish next time you open fabu.
lt_need_room: Load test: create or join a room first.
mp_quality_poor: Connection is struggling. Your changes may be delayed.
mp_recovered: Recovered your project from the last session
mpf_no_socket_b: Your browser or network blocked the connection to the server.
mpf_dns_b: The multiplayer server did not answer. It may be restarting.
mpf_offline_b: Your internet connection dropped. Waiting for it to come back.
mpf_server_down_b: The multiplayer server stopped responding. Trying to get back in.
mpf_server_sleep_b: The server was asleep. This might take a minute.
mpf_timeout_b: No reply for a while, so the connection was treated as dead.
mpf_host_gone_b: Waiting a moment in case they come back.
mpf_room_gone_b: Everyone else disconnected and the room closed.
mpf_kicked_out_t: You were removed from this room
mpf_room_full_b: The host set a player limit and it has been reached.
mpf_bad_code_b: No room is using that code right now.
mpf_send_fail_t: Your changes are not going through
mpf_send_fail_b: The connection is up but the server is not accepting messages.
mpf_gave_up_b: Your work is safe and saved locally. You can try again any time.
mpf_unknown_t: Something went wrong with the connection
mpf_unknown_b: The connection closed for an unknown reason.
mp_restore_fail: That backup could not be opened
mp_cursors_off: Live cursors are off in rooms this big, to keep the room stable.
midi_added_bpm: {n} notes imported. The file was written at {bpm} BPM.
midi_bad: That file could not be read as MIDI.
midi_empty: That MIDI file has no notes in it.
midi_smpte: That MIDI file uses film timing, which has no beat grid.
upd_backup_note: A copy of the installer is in your Downloads folder, in case anything goes wrong.
tip_timesig: How many beats are in a bar
midi_adopted: {n} notes imported. Project set to {bpm} BPM, {sig}.
help_pedal: Sustain pedal, while the keyboard is open
proll_pedal: drag the strip under the bar numbers to hold the sustain pedal
hint_drop_midi: Drop to turn this MIDI into patterns at bar {bar}.
hint_loop_key: Press L to turn looping on and off
tut_first_b: Click Instrument. That gives you a track to put music on.
tut_make_b: Double click the empty lane to the right to make a pattern.
hint_loop_made: Press L to repeat this section
hint_loop_repeat: Playing that part a lot? Press L to repeat it automatically
hint_loop_escape: Repeat is on, so the playhead stays in the loop. Press L to turn it off.
midi_bpm_body: The MIDI file you imported is written at {b} BPM. Clicking "No" leaves the tempo at your old one, not synchronized to the MIDI file.
help_pedal_edit: Paint the sustain pedal in the piano roll
help_drop_midi: Turns it into patterns you can edit
set_timesig_moved: Time signature is on the bar counter in the top bar. Click it.
export_midi: Export MIDI (the notes, for another program)
midi_export_empty: There are no notes to export yet.
mpf_relay_rate_b: The server slowed you down to keep the room usable for everyone.
mpf_relay_big_t: That was too large to send
mpf_relay_big_b: Try a shorter recording or a smaller sound file.
mpf_relay_many_b: Close some other fabu windows and try again.
mpf_relay_full_b: The room has reached the number of people the server allows.
ver_newer: You're on a newer version of fabu ({mine}) than the host ({host}). This is not your fault! You can download an older version here:
ver_older_latest: You're on an older version of fabu ({mine}) than the host ({host}). You can update to the newest version here:
ver_older_pinned: You're on an older version of fabu ({mine}) than the host ({host}). You can download this version here:
ver_host_title: You're not on the latest version!
ver_host_body: It's recommended you use the latest version of fabu. Other people might not be able to join you.
fver_body: This project was made in version {made}. You're on {mine}. This might cause problems and corrupt the file!
ver_refused_body: They are on {theirs} and this room is on {mine}. Everyone has to be on the same version. Older versions of fabu cannot show them why, so you will need to tell them.
ver_share: {who}: you need fabu {need} to join this room. Get it here: {url}
export_stems_d: One audio file per track, to mix somewhere else
export_midi_d: The notes rather than the sound, for another program
loop_new_hint: Drag a pattern from your song anywhere into this window, or drop a .fabloop file here.
loop_bad_file: That file is not a loop fabu can read.
loop_empty: That pattern has no notes in it.
loop_save_fail: There is no room left to save loops.
loop_edit_tip: Rename, change the instrument, share or delete
loop_del_body: It is only stored on this computer, so this cannot be undone.
tip_clip_drag_out: Drag the name into the Loops panel to keep this pattern
tip_humanize: Nudge timing and loudness slightly, so it sounds played rather than programmed
auto_curve_hint: Right-click a point to change how the line leaves it
mp_evade_blocked: Blocked a rejoin from {name}, on the same connection as {was}
gal_confirm_sub: Your password, once. After this fabu stays signed in for the gallery.
gal_need_signin: Sign in to see loops from people you follow.
gal_pub_sub: Anyone can find it, play it and use it in their own song. You can take it down again at any time.
gal_too_big: That loop is too big to share.
gal_daily: You have shared a lot today. Try again tomorrow.
gal_bad_name: Give the loop a name first.
gal_name_profane: Please rename the loop before sharing it.
gal_empty: Nothing here yet. Share one of your loops and it will be the first.
gal_gone: That loop is no longer there.
gal_report_sub: Tell us what is wrong with it. Enough reports and it comes down on its own.
gal_following_sub: Following each other both ways makes you friends.
gal_following_none: Nobody yet. Follow someone from their loop in the gallery.
prof_bio_ph: A line about the music you make
news_none: No release notes in this build.
gal_mine_none: No loops of your own yet. Drag a pattern from your song into the Loops window to keep one.
gal_offline: The gallery cannot be reached right now. Your own loops are under Yours and still work.
prof_need_signin: Sign in and your profile lives here: what you have shared, who follows you, and a line about the music you make.
prof_offline: These counts need the server, which is not answering. Your own loops below are kept in this browser and are unaffected.
hp_projects_sub: Everything you have opened, newest first.
hp_loops_sub: Your own loops, and loops other people have shared.
hp_profile_sub: How you look to everyone else.
hp_settings_sub: These apply to fabu itself. Settings for one song live inside that song.
tip_autom_lanes: Show a value changing over time under this track
greet_sub_late1: Some of the best ideas turn up at this hour.
greet_sub_late2: The quiet is good for this.
greet_sub_early2: You are up before everyone else.
greet_sub_morning2: A good hour to start something.
greet_sub_afternoon2: Pick up where you left off, or start fresh.
greet_sub_night1: Winding down, or just getting going?
savename_sub: It goes in your fabu projects folder.
saved_sub: {name} is in your fabu projects folder.
